response.justification: While Bogdan Szabo has extensive general software development experience, he lacks the critical mandatory requirements for this Capital Markets role. Most significantly, he has zero demonstrated Fixed Income, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets domain expertise—a mandatory qualification. His C++ experience is minimal and dated (primarily a 6-month engagement at National Instruments in 2014-2015, over a decade ago). There is no evidence of Windows platform capital markets development or strong SQL Server/Oracle expertise. His recent career trajectory in web/full-stack development and AI agents is fundamentally misaligned with the systems-level capital markets engineering required.
strengths: 17+ years of professional software development experience, exceeding the 5-10 year requirement
Demonstrated CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure expertise from Altom Consulting; proven ability to set up and maintain complex technical environments
Strong communication and mentoring abilities evidenced by multiple workshops, conference talks, and community contributions
concerns: No demonstrated Fixed Income, Investment Banking, Capital Markets, or Capital Banking domain expertise (mandatory requirement completely absent)
Minimal and outdated C++ experience (last substantial work 2014-2015, over 11 years ago); current focus is TypeScript/Node.js web development
No evidence of Windows platform development experience or strong SQL Server/Oracle database expertise; career focused on web, mobile, and embedded systems rather than capital markets systems
